subject: E-Commerce
title: AI Fraud Detection
description: A 60-second lesson on AI Fraud Detection.

hook.text: Visa's AI reviews every transaction in 1 millisecond. It checks 500+ variables and blocks $25 billion in fraud yearly.

buildup.text: AI models analyze location, device, time of day, spending patterns, and merchant type to assess risk.

discovery.text: If the AI flags a transaction, it can decline instantly, ask for verification, or allow it with monitoring.

twist.text: AI also creates false declines: legitimate purchases blocked because they look unusual. That costs $443 billion yearly.

climax.text: The challenge is balance: block fraud without blocking real customers. False declines cost 10x more than fraud.

punchline.text: AI Fraud Detection: the goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: What costs merchants more: actual fraud or false declines?
